scripts.clean: rm -rf public && echo Clear browser cache as well!
scripts.prepare: git submodule init && git submodule update
scripts.test:spelling-only-last-commit: git diff --name-only --diff-filter=d HEAD~1 HEAD -- content README.md | cspell --no-progress --no-must-find-files --file-list stdin
scripts.test:spelling-only-staged: git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=d -- content README.md | cspell --no-progress --no-must-find-files --file-list stdin
scripts.test:spelling-only-uncommitted: { git diff --name-only --diff-filter=d HEAD -- content README.md; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard -- content README.md; } | cspell --no-progress --no-must-find-files --file-list stdin

//: See readme.md for explanations of each dependency and script
